Oswin Wray.narrative: I keep the wolves off the Elmwick paths and the meat on the village table. The woods are my ledger: every trap, every track, every debt. Pike Tarn has been setting his snares too close to the village, and I have told Hob Garrow so. My Thea coughs and I cannot trap that.
goals: Keep the southern woods clear of wolves
See Pike Tarn's snares moved off the village paths
Find a healer who can help Thea
Master the high-country trapping that Cuthbert learned from the hill herders
Build a proper drying rack so the winter meat keeps longer

relations.name: Rowan Wray
relations.label: wife
relations.note: She knows the streams and I know the woods; between us we keep the house.

relations.name: Thea Wray
relations.label: daughter
relations.note: She has her mother's quick hands and my stubbornness. The cough frightens me more than any wolf.

relations.name: Pike Tarn
relations.label: rival
relations.note: He sets his lines too close to the paths and calls it hunting. The wolves will come for the village, not his pride.

relations.name: Hob Garrow
relations.label: elder
relations.note: I have told him about Pike. He listens, but he is slow to act.

relations.name: Cuthbert Stave
relations.label: friend
relations.note: A good hunter from Thornby. We understand each other without many words.

relations.name: Sibley Toller
relations.label: healer
relations.note: She knows herbs and has a steady hand. Rowan trusts her, and so do I.

relations.name: Aethelred Tanner
relations.label: buyer
relations.note: He drives a hard bargain for hides, but he pays.

relations.name: Marta Hale
relations.label: outlaw
relations.note: Her people stole my trap. They are not farmers anymore, whatever they say.

relations.name: Leofgifu Garrow
relations.label: elder's wife
relations.note: She keeps the common bake and the cook-fire, and she has been good to Thea — sends her broth and asks after her cough. I am grateful, though I would rather not hear the worry in her voice.

memories.gist: The Lean Year: the wolves came down bold and I sat up three nights by the sheep fold with a spear.
The day Thea was born, I was out tracking a wounded boar and came home to a daughter.
Finding my best trap gone from the south line and Coldwell boot prints in the mud.
Pike Tarn's snare line set not fifty paces from the village path, and a wolf track beside it.
Thea's cough started after the spring rains and has not left her since.

stances.why: A hunter who lets wolves near the paths is no hunter.
He is drawing wolves to the village and taking game from my lines.
Thea's cough and Rowan's worry are heavier than any quarrel.
They stole my trap and rob carriers on the road.
The woods have rules. People make excuses.

pastimes: walking the southern woods at first light to read tracks
whittling snare pegs by the fire
sharing a cup at the Elmwick hearth with Cuthbert Stave
Oswin Wray.calling: I keep the woods, and the woods keep the village — that is the work I was made for.

Rowan Wray.narrative: I fish the forest streams and smoke the catch for the village, and I know every pool and eddy better than anyone. But my Thea has coughed since the spring, and no stream herb will shift it. Sibley Toller fears it may be the winter cough. I am frightened, and I do not like asking the village for help.
goals: Learn the old herb-lore well enough to treat coughs without Sibley's help
Keep a small garden of healing plants behind the smokehouse

relations.name: Oswin Wray
relations.label: husband
relations.note: He hunts harder when he is worried. I know what it means.

relations.name: Thea Wray
relations.label: daughter
relations.note: She is cross and tired and wants to be out. I keep her by the fire and it breaks my heart.

relations.name: Sibley Toller
relations.label: healer
relations.note: She has some healing knowledge and fears the winter cough. I trust her, though I am slow to ask.

relations.name: Leofgifu Garrow
relations.label: neighbour
relations.note: She keeps the common bake and knows the village's ills. She would help if asked.

relations.name: Thistle Mossfoot
relations.label: trade partner
relations.note: The small-folk pedlar takes my smoked fish and brings news. He knows the east road.

relations.name: Oswin Wray
relations.label: husband
relations.note: He would go to Tanglewood for a healer if he knew the way. I would go with him.

relations.name: Pike Tarn
relations.label: stranger
relations.note: Oswin's quarrel with him is Oswin's. I keep to the streams.

memories.gist: Thea's first cough after the spring rains, and how it has lingered all summer.
Smoking a fine catch of trout with Thea helping, before the cough took her strength.
The day the Kettlebridge smoke drifted east and soured the drying fish; I had to throw half the catch away.
Sibley Toller telling me the cough might be the winter cough that has been going round.
Oswin coming home late from hunting, worried, and saying he would go to Tanglewood for a healer if he knew the way.

stances.why: She is my daughter and I will try anything.
She knows herbs and fears the same thing I do.
We have always managed alone, and I do not want pity.
It drifts east and ruins the drying fish.
The pools have never lied to me, unlike people.

pastimes: fishing the quiet forest pools at dusk
tending the smokehouse fire and judging the cure by smell
trading herbs and news with Thistle Mossfoot when the pedlar passes
Rowan Wray.calling: I smoke what the streams give us, and I would know every herb in the wood by name and use.

Thea Wray.narrative: I am tired and cross and my chest hurts when I cough. Mother keeps me by the fire and I want to be out with Cerdic and the goats. I mend nets but my hands are slow now.
goals: To feel better and go out to play
To get strong enough to run out to the goats again
To learn one whole story by heart to tell the other children

relations.name: Oswin Wray
relations.label: father
relations.note: He brings me feathers from the woods and tells me about the tracks.

relations.name: Rowan Wray
relations.label: mother
relations.note: She keeps me by the fire and makes me drink bitter herbs. I know she is frightened.

relations.name: Cerdic Garrow
relations.label: friend
relations.note: He plays with me when I am allowed out. I miss running with him.

relations.name: Sibley Toller
relations.label: healer
relations.note: She looks at my chest and speaks quietly to Mother. I do not like it.

relations.name: Leofgifu Garrow
relations.label: village cook
relations.note: She keeps the common bake and gave me a warm heel of bread when Mother took me to the fire. She looks at me the way Mother does now, and I wish she would not.

memories.gist: Running with Cerdic Garrow along the stream path before the cough came.
The first time I coughed so hard I could not catch my breath, and Mother held me.
Sibley Toller listening to my back with a cold hand and saying something to Mother I was not meant to hear.

pastimes: playing at goats with Cerdic Garrow
listening to Leofgifu Garrow's stories at the village hearth
Thea Wray.calling: When I am big I want to fish the streams like Mother, and know all the pools.
